headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas protect a green day once you're well up, catch the few big losers that wipe out many small wins, and grade the morning list against what the coins actually did.

ideas.title: Green-day lock once you're well up
ideas.why: Floor traders take more risk after gains (the house money effect). Once the day is up 5 USDT, the guard keeps at least half the day's high, allows 2 more trades and no leverage above the morning's. On 25 Oct that would have locked in about +4 instead of 9 revenge trades.

ideas.title: Big-loser check: median trade vs total
ideas.why: In Taiwan futures, the median day trade made money but the average lost, because a few big losses outweighed many small wins. /week shows your median trade and what your 5 worst trades cost, and the guard warns when an open loss passes 2× your usual loss.

ideas.title: Evening scorecard for the morning list
ideas.why: The 21:00 reminder shows how the 08:00 brief's top 5 coins moved over the next 4 hours against the scanner's own 1.5 ATR stop and 1.5R target. After 2–4 weeks you can see whether the list and its Crowded/Stretched flags actually help, from live data rather than the backtest.

sources.title: Frino, Grant & Johnstone (2008) – The house money effect and local traders on the Sydney Futures Exchange
Kuo & Lin – Overconfident Individual Day Traders: Evidence from the Taiwan Futures Market
